name: get_guides
description: Floot documentation for agents. Call with no arguments to list available guides. Pass `topic` for one guide (e.g. topic:'floot-overview') or `topics` (an array of ids) to fetch several at once. floot-overview explains how Floot projects work — read it before your first code change. Skill guides that ship seed code (marked in the list) AUTO-INJECT it into the project the first time they're loaded with a projectId — pass projectId whenever you're working on a project; idempotent, never overwrites existing files.
